column3: the Rule Engine's APPROVED/PENDING/REJECTED outcomes and their visibility rules

Lesson Comment- Like & Moderation Flow: Learner posts a clean comment on a Lesson and it is visible immediately to everyone.
column3: 1. Log in as Learner A. 2. Open a Lesson. 3. Enter a normal, on-topic comment (e.g. "Could someone explain the difference between the two tenses used here?") and submit.
column4: The Rule Engine finds no blacklist/regex match; status=APPROVED; the comment appears in the thread immediately for Learner A and is visible to any other Learner who opens the same Lesson.
column5: Learner A has access to the Lesson.

Lesson Comment- Like & Moderation Flow: A comment containing a phone number or URL is flagged suspicious (PENDING) and hidden from everyone except its author.
column3: 1. As Learner A, post a comment containing a phone number or a URL (e.g. "Contact me at 0912345678 for tutoring").
column4: The regex pattern check matches; status=PENDING; a neutral toast tells Learner A it is "awaiting moderation, visible only to you"; the comment is hidden from the public thread but still visible to Learner A when they view it.
column5: Learner A has access to the Lesson.

Lesson Comment- Like & Moderation Flow: A comment containing a blacklisted offensive keyword is REJECTED and hidden even from its own author.
column3: 1. As Learner A, post a comment containing a known blacklisted word (per `CommentRuleEngineService.BLACKLIST_KEYWORDS`).
column4: status=REJECTED; an error toast ("violates community guidelines") is shown at submit time; the comment never appears in the thread again for anyone, including Learner A on reload.
column5: Learner A has access to the Lesson; a known blacklisted keyword is available for the test.

Lesson Comment- Like & Moderation Flow: A different Learner viewing the same Lesson never sees another user's PENDING or REJECTED comments.
column3: 1. Log in as Learner B (different account). 2. Open the same Lesson used in TC02/TC03.
column4: Learner B's thread view shows only APPROVED comments (e.g. TC01's) - the PENDING comment from TC02 and the REJECTED comment from TC03 are both absent.
column5: Comments from TC01-TC03 already posted by Learner A.

Lesson Comment- Like & Moderation Flow: Editing a REJECTED comment to remove the offending word flips it back to APPROVED automatically.
column3: 1. As Learner A, open the REJECTED comment from TC03 (own comments remain editable even when rejected). 2. Edit out the blacklisted word, leaving clean text. 3. Save.
column4: The edit re-runs the same Rule Engine evaluation; with no blacklist/regex match now, status flips to APPROVED and the comment becomes visible in the thread - there is no separate "resubmit for review" step.
column5: The REJECTED comment from TC03 exists.

Lesson Comment- Like & Moderation Flow: Editing a previously clean APPROVED comment to insert a blacklisted word gets it re-evaluated to REJECTED.
column3: 1. As Learner A, open the APPROVED comment from TC01. 2. Edit it to insert a blacklisted keyword. 3. Save.
column4: The edit re-runs the Rule Engine on the new text; status changes to REJECTED and the comment disappears from the thread for everyone, including Learner A - confirming a user cannot post clean then sneak in bad content via edit.
column5: The APPROVED comment from TC01 exists.

Lesson Comment- Like & Moderation Flow: A second Learner replies to the first Learner's comment and the original author is notified.
column3: 1. Log in as Learner B. 2. Open an APPROVED root comment (e.g. a freshly re-approved TC01 after TC06 is reverted, or a new clean comment). 3. Reply to it with a clean message.
column4: The reply nests correctly under the root comment (Root -> Reply tree); assuming the reply is APPROVED, Learner A (the root comment's author) receives a CommentReply notification.
column5: An APPROVED root comment from Learner A exists.

Lesson Comment- Like & Moderation Flow: Learner likes then unlikes a comment, and the like count updates correctly both ways.
column3: 1. As Learner B, tap Like on an APPROVED comment. 2. Note the like count. 3. Tap Like again to unlike.
column4: The like count increments by 1 after liking and decrements back to the original value after unliking; the like button's visual state toggles accordingly.

column3: 1. As Learner A, open one of their own APPROVED comments. 2. Tap Delete and confirm.
column4: The comment is removed from the thread; it no longer appears on reload for any user.
column5: Learner A owns at least one comment.

Lesson Comment- Like & Moderation Flow: A Learner cannot edit or delete another user's comment.
column3: 1. As Learner B, attempt to edit or delete a comment authored by Learner A (via UI action if shown, or by targeting the comment's ID directly).
column4: The edit/delete controls are not shown for a comment Learner B does not own, and if attempted directly, the action is rejected; Learner A's comment remains unchanged.
column5: Learner A owns a comment; Learner B is logged in.

Lesson Comment- Like & Moderation Flow: Admin filters the Comment Management queue by PENDING status and finds the flagged comment with full context.
column3: 1. Log in as ADMINISTRATOR. 2. Open Comment Management. 3. Filter status=PENDING.
column4: The PENDING comment from TC02 appears in the list with its Course / Lesson-Quiz / Status / Created columns correctly populated.
column5: The PENDING comment from TC02 exists.

Lesson Comment- Like & Moderation Flow: Admin opens Comment Detail and sees the original text, normalized text, detection reason, status, author, and created time.
column3: 1. From the Comment Management list, click View Detail on the PENDING comment from TC02.
column4: The detail dialog shows Original Comment (as typed), Normalized Comment (lowercased/accent-stripped/leetspeak-normalized), Detection Reason (which regex pattern matched), Current Status, Created By, and Created Time.
column5: The PENDING comment from TC02 exists.

Lesson Comment- Like & Moderation Flow: Admin approves a PENDING comment, making it visible to everyone.
column4: status changes to APPROVED; the comment now appears in the public thread for all users, not just the original author.
column5: The PENDING comment from TC02 exists.

Lesson Comment- Like & Moderation Flow: Admin deletes a comment (including one it doesn't own) and it is removed for everyone.
column3: 1. From Comment Management, select any comment (any status/author). 2. Tap Delete and confirm.
column4: The comment is hard-deleted; it disappears from both the Admin queue and the public Lesson thread.
